data.description: Envelops the target in an illusion of being caught in a powerful, chaotic whirlpool, inducing fear and confusion.
data.battleDescription: As %user unleashes their chakra, a powerful vortex of water forms around %target, pulling them in with relentless force. The swirling waters batter %target from all sides, disorienting and overwhelming them. Within the maelstrom, illusions of drowning haunt %target's mind, intensifying their fear and confusion. As the torrent subsides, %target is left battered and shaken, the water slowly receding back into the surroundings.

data.name: Water Release: Whirlpool Water Blade
data.description: Release water chakra in a whirlpool burying your kunai within
data.battleDescription: %user starts to twirl in a frantic fashion, releasing water nature chakra, each time they twirl they hide a Kunai within the water. With a sudden stop, they launch the twirling whirlpool towards %target using the hidden kunai's to do damage

data.name: Zephyr Strike
data.description: The user imbues their weapon with a light breeze, enhancing its speed and allowing for swift and agile attacks.
data.battleDescription: As %user channels wind chakra into their weapon, a light breeze envelops them, enhancing their speed and agility. They move with a newfound swiftness, their strikes becoming faster and more precise. With each strike, the breeze around them intensifies, propelling them with the grace and speed of the wind itself.

data.name: Infernal Combo
data.description: A punch engulfed in flames, causing severe burn damage.
data.battleDescription: %user channels intense chakra, igniting their fists as they dash toward %target, unleashing a fiery combo of punches and kicks that engulf %target in searing flames.

data.name: Suiryūken
data.description: Suiryūken channels the fluidity of water into the user’s movements, enhancing endurance, agility, and recovery while reducing the impact of incoming attacks. This technique allows the user to flow through the battlefield with precision and grace, maximizing resilience and adaptability.
data.battleDescription: %user harmonizes with water, their movements fluid and resilient, reducing damage taken and enhancing stamina while overwhelming %target with unyielding grace.

data.name: Bleeding Gale
data.description: Bleeding Gales is a deadly Bukijutsu technique where the user infuses their weapon with wind chakra, transforming their strikes into powerful gusts of razor-sharp wind.
data.battleDescription: %user channels wind chakra into their weapon, causing it to hum with a sharp, dangerous energy. With a series of precise, fluid movements, %user unleashes a barrage of slashes that send invisible blades of wind tearing through %target's defenses. The winds bite deep, leaving %target with gaping wounds that bleed uncontrollably.

data.name: Wind Scythe Barrage
data.description: A sweeping assault of cutting winds that boosts the user’s offensive momentum.
data.battleDescription: %user surges forward in a blur of motion, launching a barrage of crescent-shaped wind scythes across the battlefield. As they move, chakra surges through their body, sharpening their offensive edge and enhancing the power of future attacks.

data.name: Tornado Vortex
data.description: A spiraling wind jutsu that traps and disorients foes.
data.battleDescription: %user summons a raging tornado that engulfs %target, spinning them wildly before slamming them to the ground.

data.name: Stone Circle
data.description: A ninjutsu technique that deals damage and binds the enemy’s movement.
data.battleDescription: %user slams their hands into the earth, channeling chakra that triggers a circular formation of jagged stone pillars to erupt around %target. The rising stones strike with force before closing in tightly, restricting movement and leaving the opponent vulnerable to follow-up attacks.

data.name: Chakra Resonance
data.description: A harmonic pulse that damages and stuns the enemy.
data.battleDescription: %user emits a resonating wave of chakra that crashes into %target, disrupting their flow and leaving them stunned.

data.name: Hellfire Apparition
data.description: The user's chakra emanates from them as a sweltering heat reducing the impact of all attacks that target them.
data.battleDescription: %user summons a great castle made of fire burning the air and removing all traits of healing from the battlefield

data.name: Yeti's Soul
data.description: Channel the soul of a Yeti and harness their power.
data.battleDescription: %user pulls out a forbidden scroll that he stole from Lord Pengu, within this scroll, %user pours a drop of their blood to summon a yeti's soul to the battlefield. The Soul consumes %user and they attack ferociously at %target
